form_cues: Bar sits low on the traps, not on the neck
Brace your core like you're about to take a punch
Drive knees out and sit into the squat
routine.sourceQuote: We open with heavy squats — this is a strength-focused block, so we rest fully between sets

form_cues: Lower dumbbells until elbows are at 90 degrees
Drive up and squeeze chest at the top
Control the descent — 2 counts down
exercises.sourceQuote: Into our first superset — bench press paired with rows for antagonist training

form_cues: Hinge at the hips to about 45 degrees
Drive the elbow back, not the hand
Squeeze your shoulder blade at the top
exercises.sourceQuote: Straight into rows — no rest between these two, that's the point

form_cues: Hinge from the hips with a neutral spine
Bar stays close to the legs throughout
Feel the hamstring load before driving back up
routine.sourceQuote: RDLs for the posterior chain — feel the stretch in the hamstrings

form_cues: Start with palms facing you, rotate as you press
Full range of motion — press all the way overhead
Control on the way down
exercises.sourceQuote: Second superset — Arnold press with lateral raises, great shoulder combo

form_cues: Slight bend in the elbow, pinky slightly higher than thumb
Raise to shoulder height, not above
Slow controlled descent
exercises.sourceQuote: Straight into lateral raises — burn those side delts

form_cues: Have a partner place a plate on your lower back
Neutral spine, don't let hips sag
Focus on breathing, not just holding
routine.sourceQuote: Finish with weighted planks — advanced move, have your partner load a plate
